disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS measurements of ten metals in 66 retail milk, protein milk, children's milk, yogurt, kefir and ayran products from Türkiye.

study.design: Retail market survey of packaged milk and dairy products with health-risk assessment
study.market: National and local chain stores, supermarkets and online sales platforms in Türkiye
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7800) after closed microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; Cd, Hg, Pb in no-gas mode, others in He KED mode
study.lod_text: LOD/LOQ in Supplementary Table S3 (not available)
study.qa: Spike recoveries at 100 µg/L on three samples; values in Table S3 (not available); reagent blanks

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Critical limit for Cd in milk cited by author
EU maximum level for Pb in milk (Regulation (EU) 2023/915) cited
Codex general food Hg value cited

unresolved: Sample collection dates are not reported (funding project FBA-2023-1530).
Min-max ranges for concentrations are not printed in the main text; Table 4 min-max ranges are exposure estimates, not concentrations.
LOD/LOQ and recoveries are only in Supplementary Table S3, not available with the PDF.
Text says Hg ranged <LOD-0.10 µg/L-kg across products; not stored as a separate finding.
Liquid products are per litre and cannot be compared directly with the yogurt µg/kg values.
